posts.title: Mastery in the Post-AI World
posts.description: Since I've started university, I've always felt that formal education would never be enough to become really good at my craft. I'm not even sure about what my craft is yet. I just know that I'm fascinated by technology and I've lost myself many times in trying to understand it.
